ASUS Wins Two Gold Awards at The Putra Aria Brand Awards 2022


ASUS starts the new year with a blast as they have just announced that they won two Gold Awards at the Putra Aria Brand Awards 2022.



The two Gold Winner won by ASUS fall under the “Communication Devices” category along with “Cameras, IT and Office & Business Equipment” category.



Related Posts   Pokemon Sleep Now Available In Malaysia   GamerBraves Newsletter Vol. 103 – The Glory of The Barbie/Oppenheimer Double Feature   Lenny Lin, the Business Development Manager of ASUS Malaysia says that they are honored to be recognized by all Malaysian consumers as the favorite brand in the two aforementioned categories. He also added that these awards serves as an indicator that they are on the right track and will continue to bring everyone even more exciting solutions

For those who are unaware, The Putra Aria Brand Awards was established in 2022 by the Association of Accredited Advertising Agents Malaysia. In addition, it is also one of the two recognitions endorsed by Malaysia External Trade Development Corporation as its Brand Champion Partner.
If you’d like to learn more on the event including what other awards that was given out, you can check out its official website here.

reference_summary: ASUS memenangi dua Anugerah Emas di Anugerah Jenama Putra Aria 2022 dalam kategori "Peranti Komunikasi" dan "Kamera, IT dan Peralatan Pejabat & Perniagaan". Anugerah Jenama Putra Aria, yang ditubuhkan pada 2022, diperakui oleh Perbadanan Pembangunan Perdagangan Luar Malaysia. Pengurus Pembangunan Perniagaan ASUS, Lenny Lin, melahirkan rasa terima kasih atas pengiktirafan tersebut dan menyatakan bahawa anugerah ini menunjukkan mereka berada di landasan yang betul dalam membawa penyelesaian yang menarik kepada pengguna. Maklumat lanjut mengenai acara itu boleh didapati di laman web rasmi.
